bounds.completeOrFail: If any single page exceeds row/byte limit, fail capacity with no advancement; optional deterministic smaller block windows may be chosen before querying, but never truncate returned data. A single dense block cannot be fixed by block-range paging alone. Query patch must count/limit candidate reads/staged data before array materialization to qualify hard work bounds.
bounds.initialAndReorg: Stage encrypted verified pages across explicit resumable steps. Return recovering/incomplete until whole1..head verified. bounds.incremental: Reuse only authenticated encrypted previouslyverified prefix whose checkpoint is canonical, read new blocks, verify tail previousdigest/revision and terminalhead. Newcomplete snapshot derived state must be authenticated with prefix; cache mutation/conflict fails, not merged.
bounds.importantLimit: Reviewed replay2f31 requires full events array and uses O(totalhistory) memory/hash work. It does not implement prefix continuation. A genuinely bounded production incremental reader therefore needs a separately reviewed pure streaming/prefix fold plus encrypted verified-state checkpoint, or explicitly bounded complete replay with capacity limitation left open. Do not advertise current fullreplay as bounded ingestion.
